In September 2025 I gave a talk at PyData Berlin on Bayesian consumer choice modelling — a choose-your-own-adventure in discrete choice with PyMC-Marketing. The slides can be found [here](https://nathanielf.github.io/talks/pydata_berlin_nested_logit/consumer_choice.html#/title-slide).

The recording of the talk is available on YouTube.
